name: Figma
description: Figma lets agents read design files, inspect components, styles and variables, and hand production specs to engineers. It connects to Figma's remote MCP server. Each user signs in to their own Figma account through the browser, and the Figma desktop app does not need to run.

prompts.text: Hand off the checkout file: list screens, components, and styles.
Audit this file for inconsistent spacing and color use.
Extract the marketing icons at 2x for the app bundle.

apps.name: Figma
apps.description: Design context, metadata, variables and screenshots, over Figma's remote MCP server with browser sign-in.
